gra_niedostepna: This game is missing from the profile's install
gra_osobno: chosen on the main screen, independent of the profile
strona_opis_gra: Empire Earth installations used by OpenEE. They are opened read-only – OpenEE never changes them.
strona_opis_mody: Asset overlays available to game profiles. Order in the profile = priority (lower in the list wins).
strona_opis_profile: A game profile sets the data source, content (EE / EE + AoC) and active mods. Built-in profiles are read-only.
strona_opis_ustawienia: The launcher UI language is independent of the game data language (texts, voices and campaigns).
strona_opis_narzedzia: OpenEE test scenes, automated tests and project folders.
wydanie_aoc: with The Art of Conquest expansion
okladka_podpowiedz: Title screen loaded from your game installation
jezyk_opis_pl_en: Polish texts and campaigns, original English voices.
jezyk_opis_wlasny: Custom language mix – change it in Settings.
pl_niedostepny: Polish version unavailable (no PL source installation)
mody_brak_opis: The game uses original assets only.
dodaj_mod_podpowiedz: Adds an asset overlay to the current profile (a built-in profile is copied first).
podglad_podpis: OpenEE graphics test screenshot – “Soldiers for Rome” (GOG install)
podglad_brak: No screenshot – run the test scenario from Tools
uzyj_openee: Use the OpenEE engine (instead of the original EE)
uzyj_openee_podpowiedz:
On: the button launches OpenEE (currently the test scenario).
Off: launch the original game – not connected yet.
uruchom_podpowiedz_openee: Launches OpenEE – demo mode: a scenario from the installation (no gameplay)
uruchom_podpowiedz_oryginal: Launching the original game is not connected yet
oryginal_niepodpiety: Launching the original Empire Earth is not connected in the launcher yet. Tick “Use the OpenEE engine” to start the OpenEE demo mode.
brak_instalacji_start: No Empire Earth installation found – set the path on the game card.
katalog_nie_ee: Folder %s does not contain an Empire Earth installation (no “Empire Earth/Data/data.ssa”).
mod_informacyjny: Executables and lobby files – OpenEE does not load them, so they cannot be enabled.
mody_plan: Planned: mods in OpenEE/mody/<name>/ with a mod.json manifest, dependencies and load order. For now the list is based on local layer data (dane/warstwy.json).
profil_wbudowany_uwaga: Built-in profile – use “Clone” to change it.
ust_jezyk_danych_opis: Independent language choice for texts, voices and campaigns. The Polish version comes from the community installation (read-only).
ust_pliki_opis: The launcher writes changes only to uzytkownik.cfg (and profile_uzytkownika.json). openee.cfg stays untouched.
narz_powrot: In a scene: Esc or the corner button returns to the launcher.
narz_testy_uruchomione: Tests started in the background (PID %d). Result: wyniki/testy_godot.json – refresh the page when done.
info_opis: OpenEE is an open-source reimplementation of the Empire Earth engine on Godot 4, modelled on OpenMW. The engine is new; game assets come from your legal installation.
info_dane: Game graphics, sounds and texts are read directly from the installation (read-only). The cache/ folder holds derivatives of commercial assets – for local use only.
info_licencja: Some data schemas come from EE DB Editor (GPLv3) – code using them must be GPL-compatible.
